content: The incidence rates of adverse events associated with non-aspirin NSAIDs (NAAs) are as follows: 1. For studies involving 1-2 NAAs: In prospective studies (2 studies), the incidence rate was 0.008 (95% Confidence Interval: 0.005 0.01). In retrospective studies (8 studies), the incidence rate was 0.001 (95% Confidence Interval: 0 0.002). Overall, combining both prospective and retrospective studies (10 studies), the incidence rate was 0.002 (95% Confidence Interval: 0.001 0.005). 2. For studies involving more than 3 NAAs: In prospective studies (2 studies), the incidence rate was 0.007 (95% Confidence Interval: 0.002 0.015). In retrospective studies (8 studies), the incidence rate was 0.005 (95% Confidence Interval: 0.002 0.008). Overall, combining both prospective and retrospective studies (10 studies), the incidence rate was 0.005 (95% Confidence Interval: 0.003 0.007). 3. For studies involving 25 NAAs: Overall (2 studies), the incidence rate was 0.001 (95% Confidence Interval: 0 0.008).
